# POSpire v1.1.2: Item list loads again

A fix for sites where POSpire showed no products. Nothing else changes, and there is nothing to do after upgrading.

## What was fixed

Opening the POS calls `get_items` to load the product grid. On ERPNext 16.31 and later, a POS Profile that lists item groups (or a user restricted to certain item groups) made that call fail with a server error, so the grid stayed empty. The built-in ERPNext POS was unaffected.

Item group names are quoted again before they go into the item query, including names that contain spaces or apostrophes. Profiles with no item groups are unchanged.
